name: NotebookLM
audience: Researchers, students, knowledge workers comfortable with Google's ecosystem.
positioning: Google's source-grounded AI notebook; emphasises grounding in uploaded sources.
strengths: Strong source-grounding; answers cite the uploaded material
Audio Overview is conversational and engaging
weaknesses: No spaced repetition or flashcard review loop
Generation limited to fewer artifact types than Nomi's study loop
One notebook per source-set; less cross-notebook workflow
recentAiFeatures: Audio Overviews, source-grounded chat, note suggestions.
pricingNote: Free with a Google account; premium features tied to Google AI subscriptions — do not quote prices.
commonPraise: Source grounding makes answers trustworthy; the podcast feature is delightful; clean interface.
commonComplaints: No real study / review loop; feels more like a research tool than a study tool; can't test yourself easily.
positioningVsNomi: NotebookLM is a research notebook grounded in sources; Nomi is a study loop — it ingests the same sources and adds flashcards, quizzes, spaced repetition, podcasts, and a study guide so material moves into long-term memory, not just summary.
